reuse.why: Fintegra linking reuses linkBankSyncAccount, but the replace path re-implements unlinkAccount's field-clearing update instead of sharing it, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions rather than a parameterised download.

duplication.why: Duplicates the unlink field set from unlinkAccount, the holder SELECT (in assertBankAccountNotLinked and releaseExistingLinks), the closed-account check (in the assert helper and again in linkBankSyncAccount) and the whole Akahu download function.

placement.why: Server pieces sit in the right modules (sync.ts, server-config, types), but the link preconditions are split between a provider-level assert that also checks closed state and the shared linkBankSyncAccount, which re-checks closed and performs the unlink.

scope.why: Covers the four steps; the client edits are minimal type-satisfying additions, though one step-4 behaviour lacks its own release note while the rest have them.

maintainability.why: Same rules live in two places each (closed check, holder query, unlink fields) and assertBankAccountNotLinked now mixes three concerns behind a misleading name, so future rule changes can easily diverge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: releaseExistingLinks in linkBankSyncAccount (server/accounts/app.ts) writes its own db.updateAccount clearing block instead of going through the unlink logic in unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: releaseExistingLinks reshapes unlinkAccount's clearing update into a loop, and the closed-account check is split across assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount under a shared error constant rather than one definition.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount; special-case branches for the flag in the assert, the early return in releaseExistingLinks and a second closed check inside linkBankSyncAccount; releaseExistingLinks re-implements unlinkAccount's clearing and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions.
